[[File:G-2RD-FF55.png|thumb|right|250px|A G-2RD guard droid]]
'''Guard droids''' were used by security forces and [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|law enforcement agencies]] to augment their forces and to guard sensitive locations and personnel. They were employed as [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguards]], sentries, and [[Warden/Legends|wardens]]. Their personality matrixes tended towards demanding, even abusive behavior, and their programming allowed them to use weapons in a lethal capacity if needed. They were outclassed by [[Battle droid/Legends|combat droids]] and [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] in terms of sheer combat ability, but were well equipped to handle the tasks they were assigned to handle. The [[G-2RD series guard droid]] was a notable series of guard droids produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]].
